nodes.label: Algorithms.ThompsonCanonicalSampler
nodes.subtitle: BanditRLProof.Algorithms.ThompsonCanonicalSampler
nodes.description: This module constructs the one-step joint law obtained by sampling an environment/history pair from a Bayesian prior-likelihood model and then sampling an action from the canonical posterior pushed through a measurable best-action selector. The resulting probability-matching theorem has no separate pair-law or action-law premise.
